risk_note: RV2 worker job (withdraw lane, model Claude Fable 5.1; orchestrator rulings D10-467 ④ and D10-475 ②): the review-overdue check of withdrawals (08 BR-WDR-26 超时判定; BR-WDR-24 告警) on queue payout-overdue, one five-minute slot at a time (singletonKey review-overdue:<UTC minute>, each run enqueues the next slot; seed and heal from PayoutModule.forWorker's timer, which seeds only while a withdrawal waits for a review with a deadline — anyReviewWaiting — so an empty database runs no chain, as the frozen worker wiring test [AC-B1-08w#4] requires). Candidates (review_deadline <= now, review_overdue_at IS NULL, status PENDING_REVIEW / APPROVED, every app) are judged one by one under identity's users row lock with a CAS on review_overdue_at (0 rows → skipped: rejected, paid or judged meanwhile), the event withdrawal.review_overdue {withdrawal_id, user_id, review_deadline, overdue_at} published on the same transaction, and the finance warn line withdrawal_review_overdue written only after the commit (ids and instants only; a rollback writes none). No money moves and no status changes; review_mode auto rows are judged like manual ones; quiet hours do not defer the judgement or the warn (only notification's user message, identity lane). Time only from the injected Clock. The queue catalog, worker plan and EVENT_NAMES registrations were pinned by the rule-test author's separate test(spec) commit (D10-415 ①); the 20 unchanged tests of those frozen files are red_exempt in the trusted ledger (#2054). No contract change; no migration (B2-05m's column). Test-machine full verify not run (CI verify-int, D10-319); PROP_RUNS=2000（D10-496）.
